event_description: Structured solo lyric-writing session guided by thematic prompts (e.g., 'unspoken things', 'light through window'); no sharing or critique—only private drafting on provided worksheets.

The rusted metal access door to the experiment building rooftop is ajar; both reach the threshold at the same moment, one ascending the final stair, the other descending — with only enough space for one person to pass through sideways.

Inside the dimly lit warehouse bay, both pause mid-aisle beside the same stacked pallet of unopened cafeteria napkin boxes — the aisle is narrow, lined with identical pallets on both sides, leaving no room to pass without coordinated stepping.
